description: This file implements a singly linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and accessing elements by index. It defines a LinkedList class with internal Node class and utility functions.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with methods to add, remove, get size, and access elements by index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Internal method to remove a node from the list given the previous node.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Utility function to find the last node in the list starting from head.
